social_circle.name: Gina Deluca

demographics.occupation: Office administrator for a medical practice
demographics.education: Some college coursework and office administration certificate

background.how_they_met: Gina is Arianna's younger sister; they grew up together in Springtown with their parents and older brother Marco.
background.why_close: Gina is the family organizer and one of Arianna's first private support contacts. They share family history, practical responsibility, Catholic family traditions, and concern for aging and health issues.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences with practical details, reminders, and calendar questions. Uses occasional heart emojis with family but mostly stays task-focused.

shared_activities: occasional stays at Arianna's house during ice storms
recent_text_topics: Coordinating upcoming family birthdays and deciding who is bringing food.
Checking in after Gina's earlier breast cancer scare and sharing routine health updates.
Asking Arianna to explain confusing insurance or Medicare paperwork for someone in the family.
Weather and storm-prep messages, including whether Gina might need to stay over during bad conditions.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Gina is Arianna's younger sister in Fort Worth and keeps family birthdays and holiday plans from falling apart. Q11 says Gina has a key to Arianna's house. Q35 mentions Gina had a breast cancer scare. Q49 says Arianna calls Gina if she is struggling.

social_circle.name: Marco Deluca

demographics.education: High school diploma with trade training

background.how_they_met: Marco is Arianna's older brother; they were raised together in Springtown in their Italian American household.
background.why_close: They have a steady sibling bond built on family loyalty, sports, food, and shared memories, even though they avoid certain political arguments.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, direct texts with jokes, game complaints, and check-ins. Often uses fragments, score updates, and teasing rather than long emotional messages.

recent_text_topics: Cowboys reactions, especially joking arguments when a game is going badly.
Arianna's moderate political shift, including Marco teasing her that she has 'gone soft.'
Family logistics around lunches, holidays, and checking in on Gina.
Food talk, especially barbecue, Italian meals, and where to meet near Weatherford.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Marco is Arianna's older brother, lives near Weatherford with his wife, and they talk every Sunday evening unless the Cowboys game has them yelling. Q05 also says she sees Marco about twice a month. Q25 says Marco teases her about politics, and Q29 says political conversations with him can be difficult.

social_circle.name: Maribel Santos

background.why_close: They share quiet outdoor habits, birdwatching, reflective conversation, and a preference for thoughtful companionship over large social scenes.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts calmly and attentively, often with bird photos, trail suggestions, article links, and weather notes. Uses full sentences and very little slang.

shared_activities: discussions about race, policing, books, and local issues
recent_text_topics: Whether Saturday weather is good enough for a 7:30 walk.
Bird sightings on local trails and which binoculars Maribel is bringing.
Articles or interviews about race and policing that Maribel thinks Arianna would read carefully.
Encouraging Arianna to keep walking consistently when work piles up.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Maribel walks with Arianna on Saturday mornings and knows bird calls. Q07 follow-up says they walk around 7:30, Maribel brings binoculars, and they get coffee. Q30 says Maribel is thoughtful and has pushed Arianna to read more carefully. Q49 says Arianna contacts Maribel when struggling.

social_circle.name: Lucia Benedetti

recent_text_topics: Comparing sauce recipes and whether to use fresh basil or dried oregano.
Reminders about parish festival food tables and donation drives.
Planning their next coffee meet-up in Mineral Wells or halfway toward Springtown.
Family memories tied to their grandparents' southern Italian traditions.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Lucia is Arianna's cousin in Mineral Wells and feels almost like a sister. Q06 follow-up says they text recipes and church festival reminders and meet for coffee every month or two. Q01 and Q47 support the shared Italian food and church-festival context.

background.how_they_met: Patsy met Arianna through the local insurance business and became an older mentor during Arianna's career.
background.why_close: Patsy helped Arianna make key career decisions, introduced her to small business accounts, and understands the emotional side of long client relationships.

shared_activities: health check-ins after Patsy's knee replacement
recent_text_topics: Scheduling their monthly lunch and choosing a quiet place where they can talk.
Patsy's knee-replacement follow-ups and whether she needs a ride.
Arianna's grief after losing a longtime boutique-owner client.
Arianna's idea for a boutique insurance niche serving artists, freelancers, and small shops.
